text:
sasha: Quick sync — Ops Pack add‑on scope + pricing + launch criteria. Need a decision by Mon AM. TL;DR: observability bundle (per-route token breakdown, trace links, SLO credit pool, priority support). Sales already has 3 pilot asks.

kevin: 👍 can we confirm SKUs? we need simple mapping for quoting.

maria: For pilots ask: limit Starter to 10 routes, Pro 100 routes, Enterprise unlimited. keeps ingestion predictable.

oliver: FYI engineering estimate: telemetry + storage changes will be the heavy lift. Ballpark: 6w backend + 2w console work if we scope to sampled traces and per-route aggregates only.

kevin: Pricing sketch (for discussion):
```
Ops Pack (per-org / month)
- Starter: $500 (500 SLO credits, up to 10 routes)
- Pro: $2,500 (5k SLO credits, up to 100 routes, priority support)
- Enterprise: custom (unlimited routes, table stakes + 24/7 SLA)
```

finance-bot: margin check: at those price points we need 45-50% reduction in telemetry cost via sampling + compression to hit target gross. otherwise Pro isn't viable.

amy-cs: Pilot customers: Nimbus (mid-market fintech), SlateOps (infra startup), KyraHealth (healthcare). Nimbus is most sensitive to compliance + per-route controls. KyraHealth needs HIPAA note.

maria: +1 on HIPAA note — we must mark Private deployment as required for any regulated pilot. not available on hosted until compliance signoff.

liam-eng: We can gate hosted availability: initial GA only on Dedicated/private; hosted in 3 months post-optimizations. that buys time to tune costs.

oliver: One technical ask: SLO credits are consumable tokens that map to samples stored. Proposal: 1 SLO credit = 1 sampled trace or 1k aggregated tokens. simpler for customers.

kevin: Sales feedback: customers want predictable limits not opaque sampling. need a deterministic SKU mapping + an overage policy (notify + soft-throttle).

maria: Launch criteria proposal:
- Pilot with 2 customers (one regulated, one high-throughput) signed
- Engineering perf target: <10% token-cost overhead vs baseline with sampling
- Documentation + CS runbook ready
- Contract template (add-on clause + SLA) approved by legal

finance-bot: add: must hit modeled ARR cadence for pilot pricing (min $X/month committed across pilots) or we revert to trial pricing.

amy-cs: Customers asked for a 60d pilot with option to convert. we'll need a short contract + success metrics.

kevin: Overage handling: notify at 80% of credits, then allow 7d grace before soft limit. sales wants auto-topup optional.

oliver: Implementation note: soft-throttle is easy, hard-stop is risky. prefer soft limits + manual bump.

liam-eng: Timeline if we accept this scope:
- Week 0: finalize SKU + legal clause (this week)
- Weeks 1–6: backend + sampling + storage changes
- Weeks 7–8: console features + pilot onboarding
- Week 9: pilot start

sasha: Decisions we need now (check boxes):
- [ ] Accept SKU table above (kevin)
- [ ] Pilot customers + HIPAA gating (amy/maria)
- [ ] Pricing commit threshold (finance-bot)
- [ ] Engineering timeline appt (oliver/liam)

kevin: I accept SKU table pending finance margin numbers.

finance-bot: I'll drop a simple model by EOD with break-even points and suggested adjustments.

maria: I'll mark KyraHealth as Private-only and confirm SlateOps/Nimbus for pilot.

amy-cs: I'll prep pilot playbook + success metrics template.

oliver: Eng will spin up a scoped spike this week to validate sampling savings.

sasha: OK — next steps: finance model, legal clause draft, eng spike. Sync Fri 10am to lock. Thanks all :raised_hands:
